show.description: Death Notification is a dark, gripping thriller about fate, survival, and a cursed gift. Abdul, a poor ragpicker, discovers he can see the exact time and cause of people’s deaths as glowing notifications on their foreheads. Haunted by tragedy yet determined to save lives, he walks a dangerous path—where every choice to change destiny comes with an unimaginable price.
